mods.name: Field Default Value Hook Fix
mods.description: Prevents a game crash caused by an incorrect Il2Cpp method match.

mods.name: Pocket Compendium
mods.description: Shows when bosses, elites, and fabled monsters spawn, their skill cooldowns during a fight, and the full Bestiary page of every monster.

changes: Fixes the Boss list sometimes stopping with an error.
Fixes the Skills window being too small or too large.
Shows a bar on each monster in the Bestiary that fills as you find its drops.
Makes panels, windows and hovers follow the game's Scaling UI setting.
Fixes hover tooltips of the Temple of Valaark and Old Valorath dungeon entrances.
Fixes automatic updates that downloaded but never installed.
Fixes the Bestiary countdown stopping after you switch Journal tabs.
Shows a dungeon's bosses when you hover over it on the map.
Fixes tooltips showing up empty after you change servers or log out and back in.
Asks at first start whether to install new versions by itself.
Shows new versions on the start screen instead of in chat.
Fixes Map pins and the Bestiary countdown stopping with an error after you return to the main menu and enter a world again.
Fixes the Skills window no longer opening with Bestiary pages after you return to the main menu.
Problem reports include every error, with where in the mod it happened.
First release. It replaces BossTracker, BossSkillTracker and BetterBestiary.
